lines: Asuka
Take this!! Android Arm: Rending Blade!!!!
*Slash!!*
Witch
Ughー!?
It was a decisive blow.
Asuka's Android Blade had struck with extreme speed and sliced the witch's body clean in half.
Me
Did we do it...!?
It had been a nail-biting fight.
Shikanosuke and I had kept the witch's movement in check, and Asuka targeted a slight opening to land the decisive blowー
If we had made just one mistake, we would have been the ones taken down... that was how tough of an opponent the witch had been.
Shikanosuke
Aieeee!! That was terrifying...!! But man, that Android Blade is super cool...!
Shikanosuke, who had joined the fight even though he had been scared to death, finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Butー
Asuka
Watch out, you two! It's not over yet!
Suddenly Asuka called out in a piercing voice.
At the end of her gaze was the witch who should have been bisectedー
Witch
Ugh... I underestimated you... I had no idea that you were this strong...
Me
Huh!? What's going on!?
Shikanosuke
Aieeeeee!!? Even though she got sliced up, she's talking all calmlyyyyyyy!!
Witch
Hehe... hehehe...
The witch showed no sign of collapsing and didn't seem to be in pain either.
Accompanied by her unfathomably bewitching smileーseveral scrambled lines began to run across her body.
Me
Hey, hey!? What the hell is going on!?
The number and size of the lines running across her body gradually increased.
And eventually they started to extend beyond her body and began to completely fill our field of visionー
ー*Crack!!!*
Me
Ugh!? Wh-Where are weー!?
There was a tremendous impact along with a sensation of something changingー
And we found ourselves standing in a place completely different from the cave we had been in only moments ago.
Asuka
We made it!!! The illusion was broken!!!
Shikanosuke
Oh, I know this!! This happened last time as well!!
Me
The illusion broke...? I see...
Asuka's attack must have made that much of an impact.
We had broken out of the illusion and returned to the real world.
Witch
Hehe, you kids really are troublesome... My plans are all for naught...
The witch was standing before us in perfectly good health.
She stared at us with a bewitching, but horrifying, smile on her face.
Me
You're a real witch, huh? After all, looks like your body is stuck together.
Witch
Yes. What you cut down was an illusion I createdー
The witch gently caressed her unblemished body, as if to emphasize that she was fine.
Witch
Now that my "dream" world is brokenーI really can't go easy on you, sweethearts.
Witch
This "Gate to the Devildom" belongs to usーYou understand what will happen if you get in our way, don't you?
Me
The Gate to the Devildomー
We had come back to realityーand found ourselves in a decrepit church.
Based on what the witch had just said, it was extremely likely that the "Gate to the Devildom" was somewhere in this building.
But to confirm that, we would have to fight against her once again.
Not against an illusion but against the real witchーand this time she "wouldn't go easy on us."
Me
...Well, we don't have a choice.
Asuka
That's the spirit. I'll pummel her as many times as it takes!
Shikanosuke
Uwawahhh... I'm scared of her~
At this point, retreating was not an option.
We grabbed our weapons and faced the witch.
Witch
Ehehe...♪
The witch smiled at us mysteriously and readied her weapon.
The situation was on a hair trigger.
However, at that momentー
KABOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
There was a sudden roarー
A tremor shook the entire church and fierce flames reached up from underground.
Witch
ー!? What's happening!?
A sign of unease ran across even the witch's face.
And thenー
Succubus
Mistress, a report!! There was a huge explosion at the "Gate to the Devildom" and in the corridor that leads to it!!
Succubus
The gate is badly damaged and the corridor is on fire so we can't approach it!!
The Succubus, who seemed to be a subordinate of the witch, had appeared from underground and gave a rapid-fire report.
Witch
What did you say...!?
The witch was at a loss for words.
Meanwhile, loud explosions repeatedly echoed from deep underground.
And at almost the same timeー
ーNicely done, Asuka. Thanks to you distracting that woman, things went smoothly here.
Asuka
Oh? This commotion was your doing?
It was the earring-shaped device attached to Asuka's ear.
The device also seemed to be a transmitter, and the voice coming from it was calm and somehow familiar.
Me
(It's that masked womanー!!)
Did that mean she had used us as "bait"?
While the witch had been directing her attention toward us, the masked lady had secretly infiltrated the church and blown up the "Gate to the Devildom"ー
Witch
Looks like I lost this time...
The witch, seemingly having recovered from her shock, gave an amused smile.
Witch
Now that the gate is destroyed, I have no business here. Farewell, sweethearts. Let's meet again somewhere.
Me
Ahh!? Waitー!!
I quickly shouted, but the intense fire blocking my way made it impossible to do anything else.
The witch smiled seductively and briskly disappeared with her demon subordinates.
Me
Damn it!! And we even had her back to the wallー
A mysterious woman who cooperated with demons even though she was a Taimanin.
I really had wanted to catch her and find out who she was...
Asuka
No time to stand around!! We have to go as well!! This building won't last much longer!!
Asuka shouted out.
The explosions and flames from underground had turned the church into a sea of fire in the blink of an eye.
Me
I know!! Let's get out of here, Shikanosuke!!
Shikanosuke
Aieeeeeeeeeeeee!! Don't leave me behind, you twoooooooo!!
One hour laterー
Me
What a hell of a time...
Shikanosuke
Tell me about it...
We looked upon the thoroughly collapsed church while taking shelter from the rain.
Thanks to the timely heavy rain, the flames of the church had been extinguished within an hour.
The surrounding area was a slum with hardly any inhabitants.
And it seemed like the UFS troops had withdrawn as soon as they had woken from their dreamsー
That meant that while the church had been destroyed in the blaze, the overall damage from the fire was minimal.
Me
But what is that masked woman planning...?
I suddenly asked Asuka about what had been on my mind.
Asuka
Eh? What do you mean?
Me
I mean, the UFS was trying to claim the "Gate to the Devildom," right?
Asuka
Correct. The UFS prepared a unit to do that.
Me
Right? Then why did that masked woman blow up the gate? I thought you guys were cooperating with the UFS?
I looked at Asuka's arms and legs.
It was state-of-the-art android equipmentーimpossible to maintain without somebody supporting her from behind the scenes.
Somebody like the UFSー
Asuka
Hm~? No comment♪
Me
Again!!?
Just like last time, the masked woman and Asuka didn't seem to want to talk about this incident.
Asuka
Hmmm. I'll give you a little hintーThere are a lot of people in the world with a lot of different ways of thinking.
Me
Hmmm...?
Me
(Sure, the UFS is a huge organization. It's not strange that there are various factions...)
While I was thinking, Shikanosuke suddenly spoke up.
Shikanosuke
Ah! Speaking of which, there was something bothering me as well!!
Me
What's up with you so suddenly? Something bothering youー?
Shikanosuke
Yeah!! About your "fantasy"!! It kept bothering me, so I wanted to ask!!
Me
Huh? About my fantasy...?
Shikanosuke
Yeah!! I bet you were fantasizing about something super embarrassing as well, weren't you, Fuma!?
Shikanosuke
It's not fair if only you get to see my fantasy!! Tell me about yours too!!
Me
Ughh!?
Me
(No, no, this isn't goodー!!)
Mine was about becoming the super rich and super popular student council president.
It was equally embarrassing as Shikanosuke's childish dark hero dream.
Asuka
Ahaha!! I can tell you about that, I suppose. Actually, Shikanosuke-kun, this guyー
Me
Ahh, moron!! Don't say it, Asuka!!
I hurriedly stopped Asuka, who was about to tell him with a grin on her face.
Shikanosuke
What is it~?! Tell me about it too~!!
Me
Shut up!! It's a secret, a secretー!!
Out of the frying pan and into the fire.
Now I had to fight desperately to keep my embarrassing secret hidden.
